##### Project general facts

BH Residence is an established property with a proven track record, currently undergoing a comprehensive renovation by Embrace Development. This family wellness resort features a collection of unique residences, no two units are alike. With a total of forty-six villas and apartments, the project is designed around the needs of families, multi-generational travelers, digital nomads, and wellness-focused guests, offering a fully integrated ecosystem for seamless living.

The resort offers an exceptional range of amenities tailored to its core audiences. A dedicated kids camp features age-segmented zones from nursery to teen lounge, along with Balinese art workshops, kids yoga, cooking classes, and professional nanny services. The wellness concept includes a spa and recovery zone, fitness, yoga, meditation, and breathwork practices. Architectural sleep design with orthopedic mattresses, blackout curtains, and mosquito nets is built into every unit, ensuring superior rest and recovery.

Every residence at BH Residence is crafted using only natural materials, tropical hardwood, natural stone, and organic textiles with no plastics or synthetics. High ceilings and unique layouts create open, breathable spaces. Family layouts feature master bedrooms separated from children’s rooms, dedicated staff quarters, and built-in acoustic zoning. Villas include private pools, full kitchens, laundry rooms, outdoor terraces, and storage for sports equipment, ensuring a home designed for real family living, not traditional hotel layouts.

##### Parking
Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits
Nestled on the Bukit Peninsula in the Benoa area of South Bali, this exceptional location places residents in one of the island’s most established premium residential districts. Bukit has become the primary location for high-end villa development, offering ocean views, an elevated microclimate with refreshing sea breezes, and proximity to major beaches. The area is renowned for its dramatic cliffs, world-class surf breaks, and some of Bali’s most iconic beach clubs.

The location is distinguished by its natural beauty and strategic positioning. The elevated terrain provides cooler temperatures and reduced humidity compared to other coastal areas, creating a more comfortable living environment. The peninsula offers easy access to pristine white-sand beaches, luxury resorts, fine dining establishments, and international airports, making it highly desirable for both short-term visitors and long-term residents.

For those seeking a residence that embodies coastal luxury, family-friendly living, and strong investment fundamentals, the Bukit Peninsula delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of stunning ocean views, established infrastructure, and growing international demand makes it one of Bali’s most desirable addresses. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of Bali—serene, sophisticated, and perfectly positioned.
